summary: Cyrus stands on a ridge overlooking the valley, his silhouette sharp against the purple twilight as he adjusts the dials on a long-range acoustic sensor mounted on a tripod. He watches a single spark of light ignite in the distance, his face illuminated by the flickering green glow of his tactical display as he tracks the thermal signature of the rising craft.
settingText: A tripod-mounted acoustic sensor on a rocky overlook.

dialogueInline.text: The atmospheric pressure will crush that scrap before it clears the troposphere.

summary: Arvin grips the vibrating remote ignition switch, his knuckles white, as the rocket engine roars into life behind a makeshift blast shield, kicking up a massive cloud of red dust. Lucia stands beside him, her hand hovering near the holster at her hip, watching the pillar of orange fire ascend while the ground beneath their feet rhythmically shakes.
settingText: A makeshift blast shield constructed from reinforced tanker plates.

dialogueInline.text: That's not just junk flying up there; that's the only voice they have left.

settingText: Inside the main mobile tanker workshop, surrounded by hanging copper wires and stacks of rusted heat shields.

dialogueInline.text: If this valve sticks by even a fraction of a millimeter, the pressure will turn us into a crater.

directionInline.text: ACTION — Arvin hunches over a workbench, his fingers stained with graphite and hydraulic fluid, as he meticulously scrapes a layer of calcified desert salt from a scavenged fuel injector. Milo stands opposite him, gripping a heavy wrench with both hands, his eyes tracking the precise movement of the blade while the sun catches the dust motes swirling in the stagnant air of the tanker. The physical distance between them is narrow, crowded by the metallic scent of kerosene and the heavy weight of a looming launch deadline.
SUBTEXT — Arvin's obsession with perfection is the only thing keeping them from exploding on the launchpad.
CAMERA / PERFORMANCE — Arvin's hand should tremble slightly before he steadies it with a deep, visible inhale.
CONTINUITY — The calcified fuel injector with a visible serial number: AE-09.
